title: Mystic Paw Crystal Orb
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a painted wooden table, displaying a bright neon pink paw print at its center with radiating colorful paw prints in blue, green, and yellow. The black base is labeled 'SLOT-12 SEED-12310 Fe460#3' while the misty dark background contains floating cracked purple orbs with signposts and luminous paw prints on the table surface.
prompt: A glowing crystal ball on a black base resting on a paint-splattered wooden table, inside the orb a bright neon pink central paw print radiates with colorful smaller paw prints in blue green and yellow, dark misty background with floating cracked purple spheres containing signposts, glowing paw prints on the table surface, surreal mystical atmosphere, cinematic lighting
